title: PPARgamma-AGPAT6 signaling mediates acetate-induced mTORC1 activation and milk fat synthesis in mammary epithelial cells of dairy cows.
authors: Liu, Can; Liu, Chuanping; Gong, Xiaoqing; Jiang, Yi; Yang, Yang; Zhang, Jinyou; Hou, Xiaoming; Lin, Ye
one_liner_zh: 该文研究奶牛乳腺上皮细胞中PPARgamma通过RXRalpha结合位点调控AGPAT6启动子，涉及转录因子与DNA启动子结合，但核心是代谢通路与脂质合成，缺乏AI或物理模拟方法，仅用荧光素酶实验验证结合。
abstract: This research communication investigated the role and the underlying mechanism of sn-1-acylglycerol-3-phosphate O-acyltransferase 6 (AGPAT6) in acetate-induced mTORC1 signaling activation and milk fat synthesis in dairy cow mammary epithelial cells. The data showed AGPAT6 knockdown significantly decreased acetate-induced phosphorylation of mTORC1 signaling molecules and intracellular triacylglycerol (TAG) content, whereas this inhibition effect was reversed after the addition of 16:0,18:1 phosphatidic acid (PA), suggesting that AGPAT6 could generate PA in response to acetate simulation, that in turn activates mTORC1 signaling. PPARgamma is the upstream regulator of AGPAT6 upon acetate stimulation. Luciferase assay with clones containing various deletions and mutation in AGPAT6 promoter showed that there is a RXRalpha binding sequence located at -96 bp of AGPAT6 promoter. Acetate stimulation significantly increased the interaction between PPARgamma and AGPAT6 via this RXRalpha binding site. Taken together, our data indicated that AGPAT6 could activate mTORC1 signaling by producing PA during acetate-induced milk fat synthesis, and PPARgamma acts as a transcription factor to mediate the effect of acetate on AGPAT6 via RXRalpha.
abstract_zh: 本研究通讯探讨了sn-1-酰基甘油-3-磷酸O-酰基转移酶6（AGPAT6）在乙酸诱导的奶牛乳腺上皮细胞mTORC1信号激活和乳脂合成中的作用及其潜在机制。数据显示，AGPAT6敲低显著降低了乙酸诱导的mTORC1信号分子的磷酸化及细胞内三酰甘油（TAG）含量，而添加16:0,18:1磷脂酸（PA）后，这种抑制作用被逆转，表明AGPAT6可能在乙酸刺激下生成PA，进而激活mTORC1信号。PPARgamma是乙酸刺激下AGPAT6的上游调控因子。使用含有AGPAT6启动子各种缺失和突变克隆的荧光素酶实验表明，在AGPAT6启动子-96 bp处存在一个RXRalpha结合序列。乙酸刺激通过该RXRalpha结合位点显著增强了PPARgamma与AGPAT6之间的相互作用。综上所述，我们的数据表明，AGPAT6在乙酸诱导的乳脂合成过程中通过产生PA激活mTORC1信号，而PPARgamma作为转录因子，通过RXRalpha介导乙酸对AGPAT6的作用。
